1.1: And it came to be, after the death of Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Yahoshua son of Nun, the assistant of Mosheh, saying,
1.2: “Mosheh My servant is dead, so now, arise, pass over this Yardĕn, you and all this people, to the land which I am giving to them, to the children of Yisra’ĕl.
1.3: “Every place on which the sole of your foot treads I have given you, as I spoke to Mosheh.
1.4: “From the wilderness and this Leḇanon even as far as the great river, the River Perath, all the land of the Ḥittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, is your border.
1.5: “No man is going to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Mosheh, so I am with you. I do not fail you nor forsake you.
1.6: “Be strong and courageous, for you are to let this people inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
1.7: “Only be strong and very courageous, to guard to do according to all the Torah which Mosheh My servant commanded you. Do not turn from it right or left, so that you act wisely wherever you go.
1.8: “Do not let this Book of the Torah depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you guard to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and act wisely.
1.9: “Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid, nor be discouraged, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is with you wherever you go.”
1.10: And Yahoshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
1.11: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food for yourselves, for within three days you are passing over this Yardĕn, to go in to possess the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is giving you to possess.’ ”
1.12: And Yahoshua spoke to the Re’uḇĕnites and to the Gaḏites and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, saying,
1.13: “Remember the word which Mosheh, servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, commanded you, saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is giving you rest, and He shall give you this land.’
1.14: “Let your wives, your little ones, and your livestock stay in the land which Mosheh gave you beyond the Yardĕn. But you shall pass before your brothers armed, all your brave fighters, and shall help them,
1.15: until 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has given your brothers rest, as unto you. So shall they also take possession of the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession, and shall possess that which Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave you beyond the Yardĕn toward the rising of the sun.”
1.16: And they answered Yahoshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we do, and wherever you send us we go.
1.17: “According to all that we obeyed Mosheh, so we obey you. Only, let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim be with you, as He was with Mosheh.
1.18: “Whoever rebels against your command and does not obey your words, in all that you command him, is put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

10.1: And it came to be when Aḏoni-Tseḏeq meleḵ of Yerushalayim heard that Yahoshua had captured Ai and had put it under the ban, that he had done to Ai and its meleḵ as he had done to Yeriḥo and its meleḵ, and that the inhabitants of Giḇ’on had made peace with Yisra’ĕl and were in their midst,
10.2: that they feared greatly, because Giḇ’on was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
10.3: And Aḏoni-Tseḏeq meleḵ of Yerushalayim sent to Hoham meleḵ of Ḥeḇron, and to Piram meleḵ of Yarmuth, and to Yaphiya meleḵ of Laḵish, and to Deḇir meleḵ of Eḡlon, saying,
10.4: “Come up to me and help me, and let us smite Giḇ’on, for it has made peace with Yahoshua and with the children of Yisra’ĕl.”
10.5: So the five melaḵim of the Amorites - the meleḵ of Yerushalayim, the meleḵ of Ḥeḇron, the meleḵ of Yarmuth, the meleḵ of Laḵish, the meleḵ of Eḡlon - gathered together and went up, they and all their armies, and camped before Giḇ’on and fought against it.
10.6: And the men of Giḇ’on sent to Yahoshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Do not withdraw your hand from your servants. Come up to us quickly, and save us and help us, for all the melaḵim of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have assembled against us.”
10.7: And Yahoshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the soldiers with him, and all the mighty brave men.
10.8: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Yahoshua, “Do not fear them, for I have given them into your hand. Not one of them stands before you.”
10.9: So then Yahoshua came upon them suddenly, having gone up all night from Gilgal.
10.10: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 threw them into confusion before Yisra’ĕl, and they smote them with a great smiting at Giḇ’on, and pursued them along the way that goes to Bĕyth Ḥoron, and smote them as far as Azĕqah and Maqqĕḏah.
10.11: And it came to be, as they fled before Yisra’ĕl and were on the descent of Bĕyth Ḥoron, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 threw down large hailstones from the shamayim on them as far as Azĕqah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the sons of Yisra’ĕl had slain with the sword.
10.12: Then Yahoshua spoke to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in the day when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave the Amorites over to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and he said before the eyes of Yisra’ĕl, “Sun, stand still over Giḇ’on; and moon, in the Valley of Ayalon.”
10.13: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself upon their enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Yashar? Thus the sun stopped in the midst of the shamayim, and did not hasten to go down for an entire day.
10.14: And there has been no day like that, before it or after it, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 listened to the voice of a man, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 fought for Yisra’ĕl.
10.15: So Yahoshua returned, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
10.16: Now these five melaḵim had fled and hidden themselves in a cave at Maqqĕḏah.
10.17: And it was reported to Yahoshua, saying, “The five melaḵim have been found hidden in the cave at Maqqĕḏah.”
10.18: And Yahoshua said, “Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and put men by it to guard them.
10.19: “And you, do not stand still, but pursue your enemies. And you shall smite them in the rear. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has given them into your hand.”
10.20: And it came to be, when Yahoshua and the children of Yisra’ĕl had ended smiting them with a very great smiting, till they had finished - but those who escaped went into walled cities -
10.21: that all the people returned to the camp, to Yahoshua at Maqqĕḏah, in peace. No one moved his tongue against any of the sons of Yisra’ĕl.
10.22: Then Yahoshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five melaḵim to me from the cave.”
10.23: And they did so, and brought those five melaḵim to him from the cave: the meleḵ of Yerushalayim, the meleḵ of Ḥeḇron, the meleḵ of Yarmuth, the meleḵ of Laḵish, the meleḵ of Eḡlon.
10.24: And it came to be, when they brought out those melaḵim to Yahoshua, that Yahoshua called for all the men of Yisra’ĕl, and said to the chiefs of the men of battle who went with him, “Come near, put your feet on the necks of these melaḵim.” And they drew near and put their feet on their necks.
10.25: Then Yahoshua said to them, “Do not be afraid nor be discouraged, be strong and courageous, for this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is going to do to all your enemies whom you are fighting.”
10.26: And afterward Yahoshua smote them and killed them, and hanged them on five trees. And they were hanging on the trees until evening.
10.27: And it came to be, at the time of the going down of the sun, that Yahoshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees, and threw them into the cave where they had been hidden, and laid large stones against the cave’s mouth, to this day.
10.28: And on that day Yahoshua captured Maqqĕḏah, and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and he put its meleḵ under the ban - them and all the people who were in it, he left no survivor. And he did to the meleḵ of Maqqĕḏah as he had done to the meleḵ of Yeriḥo.
10.29: Then Yahoshua passed over, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, from Maqqĕḏah to Liḇnah. And they fought against Liḇnah.
10.30: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 also gave it and its meleḵ into the hand of Yisra’ĕl. And he smote it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, he left no survivor in it. And he did to its meleḵ as he had done to the meleḵ of Yeriḥo.
10.31: Then Yahoshua passed over, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, from Liḇnah to Laḵish, and encamped against it and fought against it.
10.32: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave Laḵish into the hand of Yisra’ĕl, who captured it on the second day, and smote it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Liḇnah.
10.33: Then Horam meleḵ of Gezer came up to help Laḵish. And Yahoshua smote him and his people, until he left him no survivor.
10.34: Then Yahoshua passed over, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, from Laḵish to Eḡlon. And they encamped against it and fought against it,
10.35: and captured it on that day and smote it with the edge of the sword. And all the beings who were in it he put under the ban that day, according to all that he had done to Laḵish.
10.36: Then Yahoshua went up, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, from Eḡlon to Ḥeḇron, and they fought against it,
10.37: and captured it and smote it with the edge of the sword, and its meleḵ, and all its cities, and all the people who were in it. He left no survivor, according to all that he had done to Eḡlon, but put it and all the people who were in it under the ban.
10.38: Then Yahoshua returned, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, to Deḇir, and fought against it,
10.39: and captured it and its meleḵ and all its cities. And they smote them with the edge of the sword and put all the people who were in it under the ban, he left no survivor. As he had done to Ḥeḇron, so he did to Deḇir and its meleḵ, as he had done also to Liḇnah and its meleḵ.
10.40: Thus Yahoshua smote all the land: the mountain country and the Negeḇ and the low country and the wilderness slopes, and all their melaḵim. He left no survivor, but put all that breathed under the ban, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl had commanded.
10.41: And Yahoshua smote them from Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa as far as Azzah, and all the land of Goshen, even as far as Giḇ’on.
10.42: And Yahoshua captured all these melaḵim and their land at one time, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl fought for Yisra’ĕl.
10.43: And Yahoshua returned, and all Yisra’ĕl with him, to the camp at Gilgal.

11.1: And it came to be, when Yaḇin meleḵ of Ḥatsor heard, that he sent to Yoḇaḇ meleḵ of Maḏon, and to the meleḵ of Shimron, and to the meleḵ of Aḵshaph,
11.2: and to the melaḵim who were from the north, in the mountains, and in the desert plain south of Kinneroth, and in the low country, and in the heights of Dor on the west -
11.3: the Kena’anites in the east and in the west, and the Amorite, and the Ḥittite, and the Perizzite, and the Yeḇusite in the mountains, and the Ḥiwwite below Ḥermon in the land of Mitspah.
11.4: And they went out, they and all their armies with them, as many people as numerous as the sand on the seashore, with very many horses and chariots.
11.5: And all these melaḵim met together, and they came and camped together at the waters of Mĕrom to fight against Yisra’ĕl.
11.6: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Yahoshua, “Do not be afraid of their presence, for tomorrow about this time I am giving all of them over to Yisra’ĕl, slain. Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”
11.7: And Yahoshua, and all the soldiers with him, came against them suddenly by the waters of Mĕrom, and they fell on them.
11.8: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave them into the hand of Yisra’ĕl, and they smote them and pursued them to Great Tsiḏon, and to Misrephoth Mayim, and to the Valley of Mitspĕh eastward. And they smote them until no survivor was left to them.
11.9: And Yahoshua did to them as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
11.10: And Yahoshua turned back at that time and captured Ḥatsor, and smote its meleḵ with the sword, for Ḥatsor was formerly the head of all those reigns.
11.11: And they smote all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, putting them under the ban. He did not leave anyone breathing. Then he burned Ḥatsor with fire.
11.12: And Yahoshua captured all the cities of those melaḵim, and all their melaḵim, and he smote them with the edge of the sword. He put them under the ban, as Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded.
11.13: However, Yisra’ĕl did not burn any cities that stood on their mounds, but Yahoshua burned only Ḥatsor.
11.14: And all the spoil of these cities and the livestock, the children of Yisra’ĕl took as booty for themselves. But they smote every man with the edge of the sword until they had destroyed them, and they did not leave anyone breathing.
11.15: As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh his servant, so Mosheh commanded Yahoshua, and so Yahoshua did. He did not turn aside a word of all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh.
11.16: Thus Yahoshua took all this land: the mountain country, and all the Negeḇ, and all the land of Goshen, and the low country, and the desert plain, and the mountains of Yisra’ĕl and its low lands,
11.17: from Mount Ḥalaq that goes up to Sĕ’ir, and as far as Ba’al Gaḏ in the Valley of Leḇanon below Mount Ḥermon. And he captured all their melaḵim, and smote them and killed them.
11.18: Yahoshua fought with all those melaḵim for a long time.
11.19: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Yisra’ĕl, except the Ḥiwwites, the inhabitants of Giḇ’on. All the others they took in battle.
11.20: For it was of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to harden their hearts, that they should come against Yisra’ĕl in battle, in order to put them under the ban, so that they might have no favor, but that He might annihilate them, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh.
11.21: And at that time Yahoshua came and cut off the Anaqim from the mountains, from Ḥeḇron, from Deḇir, from Anaḇ, and from all the mountains of Yahuḏah, and from all the mountains of Yisra’ĕl. Yahoshua put them with their cities under the ban.
11.22: There were none of the Anaqim left in the land of the children of Yisra’ĕl; only in Azzah, in Gath, and in Ashdoḏ some remained.
11.23: Thus Yahoshua took the entire land, according to all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had said to Mosheh. And Yahoshua gave it as an inheritance to Yisra’ĕl according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from fighting.

12.1: And these are the melaḵim of the land whom the children of Yisra’ĕl smote, and whose land they possessed beyond the Yardĕn towards the sun-rising, from the wadi Arnon to Mount Ḥermon, and all the desert plain eastward:
12.2: Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites, who dwelt in Ḥeshbon, ruling from Aro’ĕr, which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, from the middle of that wadi, and half Gil’aḏ, even as far as the wadi Yabboq, the border of the children of Ammon,
12.3: and the desert plain from the Sea of Kinneroth eastward as far as the Sea of the Araḇah, the Salt Sea, the way to Bĕyth Yeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah,
12.4: and the border of Oḡ, meleḵ of Bashan, who was of the remnant of the Repha’ites, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Eḏre’i,
12.5: and ruled in Mount Ḥermon, and in Salḵah, and in all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Ma’aḵathites, and the half of Gil’aḏ as far as the border of Siḥon meleḵ of Ḥeshbon.
12.6: Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and the children of Yisra’ĕl had smitten them. And Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had given it as a possession to the Re’uḇĕnites, and to the Gaḏites, and to half the tribe of Menashsheh.
12.7: And these are the melaḵim of the land which Yahoshua and the children of Yisra’ĕl smote beyond the Yardĕn, on the west, from Ba’al Gaḏ in the Valley of Leḇanon as far as Mount Ḥalaq that goes up to Sĕ’ir, which Yahoshua gave to the tribes of Yisra’ĕl as a possession according to their divisions,
12.8: in the mountain country, and in the low country, and in the desert plain, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the Negeḇ, the Ḥittites, the Amorites and the Kena’anites, the Perizzites, the Ḥiwwites, and the Yeḇusites:
12.9: the meleḵ of Yeriḥo, one; the meleḵ of Ai, which is beside Bĕyth Ĕl, one;
12.10: the meleḵ of Yerushalayim, one; the meleḵ of Ḥeḇron, one;
12.11: the meleḵ of Yarmuth, one; the meleḵ of Laḵish, one;
12.12: the meleḵ of Eḡlon, one; the meleḵ of Gezer, one;
12.13: the meleḵ of Deḇir, one; the meleḵ of Geḏer, one;
12.14: the meleḵ of Ḥormah, one; the meleḵ of Araḏ, one;
12.15: the meleḵ of Liḇnah, one; the meleḵ of Aḏullam, one;
12.16: the meleḵ of Maqqĕḏah, one; the meleḵ of Bĕyth Ĕl, one;
12.17: the meleḵ of Tappuaḥ, one; the meleḵ of Ḥĕpher, one;
12.18: the meleḵ of Aphĕq, one; the meleḵ of Sharon, one;
12.19: the meleḵ of Maḏon, one; the meleḵ of Ḥatsor, one;
12.20: the meleḵ of Shimron Mĕron, one; the meleḵ of Aḵshaph, one;
12.21: the meleḵ of Ta’anaḵ, one; the meleḵ of Meḡiddo, one;
12.22: the meleḵ of Qeḏesh, one; the meleḵ of Yoqne’am in Karmel, one;
12.23: the meleḵ of Dor in the heights of Dor, one; the meleḵ of the nations of Gilgal, one;
12.24: the meleḵ of Tirtsah, one. Thirty-one melaḵim in all.

13.1: And Yahoshua was old, advanced in years. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to him, “You are old, advanced in years, and still much of the land remains to be possessed.
13.2: “This is the land that remains: all the districts of the Pelishtites and all the Geshurites,
13.3: from Shiḥor which is in front of Mitsrayim, and up to the border of Eqron northward, are considered as Kena’anite - the five princes of the Pelishtites, the Azzathites, and the Ashdoḏites, the Eshqelonites, the Gittites, and the Eqronites; also the Awwites
13.4: on the south; all the land of the Kena’anites, and Me’arah that belongs to the Tsiḏonians as far as Aphĕq, to the border of the Amorites;
13.5: and the land of the Geḇalites, and all Leḇanon, toward the sunrise, from Ba’al Gaḏ below Mount Ḥermon as far as the entrance to Ḥamath;
13.6: all the inhabitants of the mountains from Leḇanon as far as Misrephoth Mayim, and all the Tsiḏonians. I Myself drive them out from before the children of Yisra’ĕl. Only, divide it by lot to Yisra’ĕl as an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
13.7: “And now, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Menashsheh.”
13.8: With them the other half tribe the Re’uḇĕnites and the Gaḏites received their inheritance, which Mosheh had given them, beyond the Yardĕn eastward, as Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had given them:
13.9: from Aro’ĕr which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the wadi, and all the plain of Mĕyḏeḇa as far as Diḇon;
13.10: and all the cities of Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites, who reigned in Ḥeshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon;
13.11: and Gil’aḏ, and the border of the Geshurites, and of the Ma’aḵathites, and all Mount Ḥermon, and all Bashan as far as Salḵah;
13.12: all the reign of Oḡ in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Eḏre’i, who remained of the remnant of the Repha’ites, for Mosheh had smitten and dispossessed them.
13.13: However, the children of Yisra’ĕl did not drive out the Geshurites nor the Ma’aḵathites, so the Geshurites and the Ma’aḵathites dwell in the midst of Yisra’ĕl to this day.
13.14: Only to the tribe of Lĕwi he gave no inheritance - the offerings made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl were their inheritance, as He said to them.
13.15: And Mosheh gave to the tribe of the children of Re’uḇĕn, for their clans:
13.16: and their border was from Aro’ĕr, which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the wadi, and all the plain by Mĕyḏeḇa,
13.17: Ḥeshbon and all its cities that are in the plain: Diḇon, and Bamoth Ba’al, and Bĕyth Ba’al Me’on,
13.18: and Yahtsah, and Qeḏĕmoth, and Mĕpha’ath,
13.19: and Qiryathayim, and Siḇmah, and Tsereth Shaḥar on the mountain of the valley,
13.20: and Bĕyth Pe’or, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Bĕyth Yeshimoth;
13.21: and all the cities of the tableland, and all the reign of Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites, who reigned in Ḥeshbon, whom Mosheh had smitten with the princes of Miḏyan: Ewi, and Reqem, and Tsur, and Ḥur, and Reḇa, princes of Siḥon dwelling in the land.
13.22: And the sons of Yisra’ĕl killed with the sword Bil’am son of Be’or, the diviner, among those who were killed by them.
13.23: And the border of the children of Re’uḇĕn was the bank of the Yardĕn. This was the inheritance of the children of Re’uḇĕn for their clans, the cities and their villages.
13.24: And Mosheh gave to the tribe of Gaḏ, to the children of Gaḏ for their clans:
13.25: and their border was Ya’zĕr, and all the cities of Gil’aḏ, and half the land of the children of Ammon as far as Aro’ĕr, which is before Rabbah,
13.26: and from Ḥeshbon to Ramath Mitspĕh and Betonim, and Maḥanayim to the border of Deḇir,
13.27: and in the valley Bĕyth ha’Ram, and Bĕyth Nimrah, and Sukkoth, and Tsaphon, the rest of the reign of Siḥon meleḵ of Ḥeshbon, the Yardĕn being its border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Kinnereth, beyond the Yardĕn eastward.
13.28: This is the inheritance of the children of Gaḏ for their clans, the cities and their villages.
13.29: And Mosheh gave to half the tribe of Menashsheh, and it was for half the tribe of the children of Menashsheh for their clans:
13.30: and their border was from Maḥanayim, all Bashan, all the reign of Oḡ meleḵ of Bashan, and all the small towns of Ya’ir which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
13.31: and the half of Gil’aḏ, and Ashtaroth and Eḏre’i, cities of the reign of Oḡ in Bashan, were for the children of Maḵir son of Menashsheh, to the half of the children of Maḵir for their clans.
13.32: These Mosheh gave as an inheritance in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ beyond the Yardĕn, by Yeriḥo eastward.
13.33: But to the tribe of Lĕwi Mosheh gave no inheritance. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Elohim of Yisra’ĕl, He was their inheritance, as He had said to them.

14.1: Now these the children of Yisra’ĕl inherited in the land of Kena’an, which El’azar the kohĕn, and Yahoshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl caused them to inherit.
14.2: Their inheritance was by lot, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded by the hand of Mosheh, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
14.3: For Mosheh had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Yardĕn, but to the Lĕwites he gave no inheritance in their midst.
14.4: For the children of Yosĕph had become two tribes: Menashsheh and Ephrayim. And they gave no part to the Lĕwites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their open land for their livestock and their possessions.
14.5: As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did, and they divided the land.
14.6: And the children of Yahuḏah came to Yahoshua in Gilgal, and Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite said to him, “You know the word which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Mosheh the man of Elohim concerning you and me in Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa.
14.7: “I was forty years old when Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sent me from Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa to spy out the land, and I brought back word to him as it was in my heart.
14.8: “But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, but I followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim completely.
14.9: “So Mosheh swore on that day, saying, ‘The land on which your foot has trodden is your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim completely.’
14.10: “And now, see, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has kept me alive, as He said, these forty-five years since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke this word to Mosheh while Yisra’ĕl walked in the wilderness. And now, see, I am eighty-five years old today.
14.11: “Yet I am still as strong today as I was on the day that Mosheh sent me. As my strength was then, so my strength is now, for battle, and for going out and for coming in.
14.12: “And now, give me this mountain of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke in that day, for you heard in that day how the Anaqim were there, and that the cities were great and walled. If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is with me, then I shall dispossess them, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said.”
14.13: Yahoshua then baraḵ him, and gave Ḥeḇron to Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh as an inheritance.
14.14: So Ḥeḇron became the inheritance of Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite to this day, because he followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl completely.
14.15: Now the name of Ḥeḇron was formerly Qiryath Arba, the greatest man among the Anaqim. And the land had rest from fighting.

15.1: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Yahuḏah for their clans was to the border of Eḏom, the Wilderness of Tsin southward in the extreme south.
15.2: And their southern border began at the edge of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.
15.3: And it went out to the southern side of the Ascent of Aqrabbim, passed over to Tsin, and went up on the south side of Qaḏĕsh Barnĕa, and passed over to Ḥetsron, went up to Addar, and went around to Qarqa,
15.4: and passed over to Atsmon, and went out to the wadi of Mitsrayim, and the border ended at the sea. This is your southern border.
15.5: And the east border was the Salt Sea as far as the end of the Yardĕn. And the border on the northern quarter began at the bay of the sea at the end of the Yardĕn.
15.6: And the border went up to Bĕyth Ḥoḡlah and passed over north of Bĕyth Araḇah. And the border went up to the stone of Bohan son of Re’uḇĕn.
15.7: And the border went up toward Deḇir from the Valley of Aḵor, and it turned northward toward Gilgal, which is before the Ascent of Aḏummim, which is south of the wadi. And the border passed over to the waters of Ĕyn Shemesh and ended at Ĕyn Roḡĕl.
15.8: And the border went up by the Valley of Bĕn Hinnom to the southern slope of the Yeḇusite city, that is Yerushalayim. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the Valley of Repha’im northward.
15.9: And the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtowaḥ, and went up to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Ba’alah, that is Qiryath Ye’arim.
15.10: And the border turned around from Ba’alah westward to Mount Sĕ’ir, and passed over to the side of Mount Ye’arim on the north, that is Kesalon, and went down to Bĕyth Shemesh, and passed over to Timnah.
15.11: And the border went out to the side of Eqron northward. And the border went around to Shikkeron, and passed over to Mount Ba’alah, and went out to Yaḇne’ĕl. And the border ended at the sea.
15.12: And the west border was the coastline of the Great Sea. This is the boundary of the children of Yahuḏah all around for their clans.
15.13: And to Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Yahuḏah, according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to Yahoshua: Qiryath Arba, that is Ḥeḇron - Arba was the father of Anaq.
15.14: And Kalĕḇ drove out the three sons of Anaq from there: Shĕshai, and Aḥiman, and Talmai, the children of Anaq.
15.15: And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Deḇir, and the name of Deḇir formerly was Qiryath Sĕpher.
15.16: And Kalĕḇ said, “He who smites Qiryath Sĕpher and shall capture it, to him I shall give Aḵsah my daughter as wife.”
15.17: And Othni’ĕl son of Qenaz, the brother of Kalĕḇ, captured it, so he gave him Aḵsah his daughter as wife.
15.18: And it came to be, when she came to him, that she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. And when she got off from the donkey, Kalĕḇ said to her, “What is the matter?”
15.19: And she said, “Give me a beraḵah. Since you have given me land in the Negeḇ, give me also fountains of water.” And he gave her the upper fountains and the lower fountains.
15.20: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yahuḏah for their clans:
15.21: And the cities at the furthest border of the tribe of the children of Yahuḏah, toward the border of Eḏom in the Negeḇ, were Qaḇtse’ĕl, and Ĕḏer, and Yaḡur,
15.22: and Qinah, and Dimonah, and Aḏaḏah,
15.23: and Qeḏesh, and Ḥatsor, and Yithnan,
15.25: and Ḥatsor, Ḥaḏattah, and Qeriyoth, Ḥetsron, that is Ḥatsor,
15.27: and Ḥatsar Gaddah, and Ḥeshmon, and Bĕyth Pelet,
15.28: and Ḥatsar Shu’al, and Be’ĕrsheḇa, and Bizyothyah,
15.30: and Eltolaḏ, and Kesil, and Ḥormah,
15.31: and Tsiqlaḡ, and Maḏmannah, and Sansannah,
15.32: and Leḇa’oth, and Shilḥim, and Ayin, and Rimmon. All the cities were twenty-nine, with their villages.
15.33: In the low country: Eshta’ol, and Tsor’ah, and Ashnah,
15.34: and Zanowaḥ, and Ĕyn Gannim, Tappuaḥ and Ĕynam,
15.35: Yarmuth and Aḏullam, Soḵoh and Azĕqah,
15.36: and Sha’arayim, and Aḏithayim, and Geḏĕrah, and Geḏĕrothayim - fourteen cities with their villages.
15.37: Tsenan, and Ḥaḏashah, and Miḡdal Gaḏ,
15.38: and Dil’an, and Mitspĕh, and Yoqthe’ĕl,
15.40: and Kabbon, and Laḥmam, and Kithlish,
15.41: and Geḏĕroth, Bĕyth Daḡon, and Na’amah, and Maqqĕḏah - sixteen cities with their villages.
15.43: and Yiphtaḥ, and Ashnah, and Netsiḇ,
15.44: and Qe’ilah, and Aḵziḇ, and Marĕshah - nine cities with their villages.
15.45: Eqron with its towns and its villages,
15.46: from Eqron to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdoḏ, with their villages.
15.47: Ashdoḏ, its towns and its villages; Azzah, its towns and its villages; as far as the wadi of Mitsrayim and the Great Sea with its coastline.
15.48: And in the mountain country: Shamir, and Yattir, and Soḵoh,
15.49: and Dannah, and Qiryath Sannah, that is Deḇir,
15.50: and Anaḇ, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
15.51: and Goshen, and Ḥolon, and Giloh - eleven cities with their villages.
15.53: and Yanim, and Bĕyth Tappuaḥ, and Aphĕqah,
15.54: and Ḥumtah, and Qiryath Arba, that is Ḥeḇron, and Tsi’or - nine cities with their villages.
15.55: Ma’on, Karmel, and Ziph, and Yuttah,
15.56: and Yizre’ĕl, and Yoqḏe’am, and Zanowaḥ,
15.57: Qayin, Giḇ’ah, and Timnah - ten cities with their villages.
15.59: and Ma’arath, and Bĕyth Anoth, and Elteqon - six cities with their villages.
15.60: Qiryath Ba’al, that is Qiryath Ye’arim, and Rabbah - two cities with their villages.
15.61: In the wilderness: Bĕyth Araḇah, Middin, and Seḵaḵah,
15.62: and Niḇshan, and the City of Salt, and Ĕyn Geḏi - six cities with their villages.
15.63: As for the Yeḇusites, the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, the children of Yahuḏah were unable to drive them out, so the Yeḇusites have dwelt with the children of Yahuḏah at Yerushalayim to this day.

16.1: And the lot for the children of Yosĕph went out from the Yardĕn, by Yeriḥo, to the waters of Yeriḥo on the east, to the wilderness going up from Yeriḥo through the mountains to Bĕyth Ĕl,
16.2: and went out from Bĕyth Ĕl to Luz, and passed over to the border of the Arkites at Ataroth,
16.3: and went down westward to the boundary of the Yaphlĕtites, as far as the boundary of Lower Bĕyth Ḥoron to Gezer, and it ended at the sea.
16.4: Thus the children of Yosĕph, Menashsheh and Ephrayim, inherited.
16.5: And the border of the children of Ephrayim, according to their clans, was: The border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth Addar as far as Upper Bĕyth Ḥoron.
16.6: And the border went out toward the sea, to Miḵmethath on the north, then the border went around eastward to Ta’anath Shiloh, and passed over it on the east of Yanoḥah,
16.7: and went down from Yanoḥah to Ataroth and Na’arah, reached to Yeriḥo, and came out at the Yardĕn.
16.8: From Tappuaḥ the border went westward to the wadi Qanah, and it ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephrayim for their clans.
16.9: And the separate cities for the children of Ephrayim were in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Menashsheh, all the cities with their villages.
16.10: And they did not drive out the Kena’anites who dwelt in Gezer, so the Kena’anites dwell among the Ephrayimites to this day and have become compulsory labor.

17.1: And the lot for the tribe of Menashsheh, for he was the first-born of Yosĕph, was: for Maḵir the first-born of Menashsheh, father of Gil’aḏ, because he was a man of battle, therefore he had Gil’aḏ and Bashan.
17.2: And for the rest of the children of Menashsheh for their clans there was: for the children of Aḇi’ezer, and for the children of Ḥĕleq, and for the children of Asri’ĕl, and for the children of Sheḵem, and for the children of Ḥĕpher, and for the children of Shemiḏa. These were the male children of Menashsheh son of Yosĕph according to their clans.
17.3: But Tselapheḥaḏ son of Ḥĕpher, son of Gil’aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh, had no sons, but only daughters. And these were the names of his daughters: Maḥlah and No’ah, Ḥoḡlah, Milkah and Tirtsah.
17.4: And they came near before El’azar the kohĕn, before Yahoshua son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded Mosheh to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
17.5: And ten portions fell to Menashsheh, besides the land of Gil’aḏ and Bashan, which were beyond the Yardĕn,
17.6: because the daughters Menashsheh received an inheritance among his sons. And the rest of Menashsheh’s sons had the land of Gil’aḏ.
17.7: And the border of Menashsheh was from Ashĕr to Miḵmethath, which faces Sheḵem. And the border went up to the right to the inhabitants of Ĕyn Tappuaḥ.
17.8: The land of Tappuaḥ belonged to Menashsheh, but Tappuaḥ on the border of Menashsheh belonged to the children of Ephrayim.
17.9: And the border went down to the wadi Qanah, southward to the wadi. These cities of Ephrayim were in the midst of the cities of Menashsheh, but the border of Menashsheh was north of the wadi, and it ended at the sea.
17.10: Southward it was Ephrayim’s, and northward it was Menashsheh’s, and the sea was its border, and they reached to Ashĕr on the north and to Yissasḵar on the east.
17.11: And in Yissasḵar and in Ashĕr, Menashsheh had Bĕyth She’an and its towns, and Yiḇle’am and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Ĕyn Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Ta’anaḵ and its towns, and the inhabitants of Meḡiddo and its towns - three of the heights.
17.12: But the children of Menashsheh were unable to drive out the inhabitants of those cities, for the Kena’anites desired to dwell in that land.
17.13: And it came to be, when the children of Yisra’ĕl were strong, that they put the Kena’anites to compulsory labor, but did not utterly drive them out.
17.14: And the children of Yosĕph spoke to Yahoshua, saying, “Why have you given us but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing we are a great people whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has baraḵ until now?”
17.15: And Yahoshua said to them, “If you are a great people, go up to the forest and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the Repha’ites, since the hill country of Ephrayim is too narrow for you.”
17.16: Then the children of Yosĕph said, “The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Kena’anites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are of Bĕyth She’an and its towns and those who are of the Valley of Yizre’ĕl.”
17.17: And Yahoshua spoke to the house of Yosĕph, to Ephrayim and to Menashsheh, saying, “You are a great people and have great power, you are not to have one lot,
17.18: for the hill country shall be yours. For though it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and its farthest limits shall be yours. For you are to drive out the Kena’anites, though they have iron chariots and are strong.”

18.1: And all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl assembled at Shiloh, and they let the Tent of Appointment dwell there. And the land was subdued before them.
18.2: And seven tribes were left among the children of Yisra’ĕl who had not yet shared their inheritance.
18.3: So Yahoshua said to the children of Yisra’ĕl, “Till when are you going to fail to go in and possess the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of your fathers has given you?
18.4: “Appoint three men from each tribe, and let me send them out to go through the land and describe it according to their inheritance, and come back to me.
18.5: “And they shall divide it into seven portions - Yahuḏah stays within their border on the south, and the house of Yosĕph stays within their border on the north -
18.6: and you shall describe the land in seven portions, and shall bring it to me. Then I shall cast lots for you here before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim.
18.7: “But the Lĕwites have no portion among you, for the kehunnah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is their inheritance. And Gaḏ, and Re’uḇĕn, and half the tribe of Menashsheh have received their inheritance beyond the Yardĕn on the east, which Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave them.”
18.8: So the men rose up and went. And Yahoshua commanded those who went to describe the land, saying, “Go, walk through the land, and describe it, and come back to me, and let me cast lots for you here before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in Shiloh.”
18.9: So the men went, and passed through the land, and described it in a book in seven portions by cities. And they came to Yahoshua at the camp in Shiloh.
18.10: And Yahoshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and there Yahoshua divided the land to the children of Yisra’ĕl according to their portions.
18.11: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Binyamin came up for their clans, and the border of their lot came out between the children of Yahuḏah and the children of Yosĕph.
18.12: And their border was on the north side from the Yardĕn, and the border went up to the side of Yeriḥo on the north, and went up through the mountains westward, and ended at the Wilderness of Bĕyth Awen.
18.13: And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz, that is Bĕyth Ĕl, southward. And the border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the hill that lies on the south side of Lower Bĕyth Ḥoron.
18.14: And the border was drawn and went around the west side to the south, from the hill that faces Bĕyth Ḥoron southward, and it ended at Qiryath Ba’al, that is Qiryath Ye’arim, a city of the children of Yahuḏah. This was the west side.
18.15: And the south side was from the end of Qiryath Ye’arim, and the border went out westward, and went out to the fountain of the waters of Nephtowaḥ.
18.16: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that faces the Valley of Bĕn Hinnom, which is in the Valley of the Repha’im on the north, and went down to the Valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Yeḇusite city on the south, and went down to Ĕyn Roḡĕl.
18.17: And it was drawn from the north, went out to Ĕyn Shemesh, and went out toward Geliloth, which is opposite the Ascent of Aḏummim, and went down to the stone of Bohan son of Re’uḇĕn,
18.18: and passed over to the side opposite Araḇah northward, and went down to Araḇah.
18.19: And the border passed over to the side of Bĕyth Ḥoḡlah northward, and the border ended at the north bay at the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Yardĕn. This was the southern boundary,
18.20: and the Yardĕn borders it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Binyamin, according to its boundaries all around, for their clans.
18.21: And the cities for the tribe of the children of Binyamin, for their clans, were Yeriḥo, and Bĕyth Ḥoḡlah, and Ĕmeq Qetsits,
18.22: and Bĕyth Araḇah, Tsemarayim, and Bĕyth Ĕl,
18.24: and Kephar ha’Ammoni, and Ophni, and Gaḇa - twelve cities with their villages.
18.26: and Mitspĕh, and Kephirah, and Motsah,
18.27: and Reqem, and Yirpe’ĕl, and Taralah,
18.28: and Tsela, Eleph, and the Yeḇusite, that is Yerushalayim, Giḇ’ath and Qiryath - fourteen cities with their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Binyamin for their clans.

19.1: And the second lot came out for Shim’on, for the tribe of the children of Shim’on for their clans. And their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Yahuḏah.
19.2: And they had in their inheritance Be’ĕrsheḇa, or Sheḇa, and Molaḏah,
19.3: and Ḥatsar Shu’al, and Balah, and Etsem,
19.4: and Eltolaḏ, and Bethul, and Ḥormah,
19.5: and Tsiqlaḡ, and Bĕyth Markaḇoth, and Ḥatsar Susah,
19.6: and Bĕyth Leḇa’oth, and Sharuḥen - thirteen cities and their villages.
19.7: Ayin, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan - four cities and their villages;
19.8: and all the villages that were all around these cities as far as Ba’alath Be’ĕr, Ramath Negeḇ. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Shim’on for their clans.
19.9: The inheritance of the children of Shim’on was out of the portion of the children of Yahuḏah, for the portion of the children of Yahuḏah was too much for them. So the children of Shim’on had their inheritance within their inheritance.
19.10: And the third lot came up for the children of Zeḇulun for their clans, and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sariḏ.
19.11: And their border went toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth, and reached to the wadi that faced Yoqne’am,
19.12: and turned back from Sariḏ eastward toward the sunrise, to the border of Kisloth Taḇor, and went out toward Daḇerath, and went up to Yaphiya.
19.13: And from there it passed over eastward, to the east of Gath Ḥĕpher, toward Eth Qatsin, and went out to Rimmon, which borders on Nĕ’ah.
19.14: And the border went around it on the north side of Ḥannathon, and it ended in the Valley of Yiphthaḥ Ĕl;
19.15: also Qattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Yiḏalah, and Bĕyth Leḥem - twelve cities with their villages.
19.16: This was the inheritance of the children of Zeḇulun for their clans, these cities with their villages.
19.17: The fourth lot came out Yissasḵar, for the children Yissasḵar, for their clans.
19.18: And their border was toward Yizre’ĕl, and Kesulloth, and Shunĕm,
19.19: and Ḥapharayim, and Shiyon, and Anaḥarath,
19.20: and Rabbith, and Qishyon, and Eḇets,
19.21: and Remeth, and Ĕyn Gannim, and Ĕyn Ḥaddah, and Bĕyth Patstsĕts.
19.22: And the border reached to Taḇor, and Shaḥatsimah, and Bĕyth Shemesh, and their border ended at the Yardĕn - sixteen cities with their villages.
19.23: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Yissasḵar for their clans, the cities and their villages.
19.24: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Ashĕr for their clans.
19.25: And their border was Ḥelqath, and Ḥali, and Beten, and Aḵshaph,
19.26: and Allammeleḵ, and Amaḏ, and Mish’al. And it reached to Mount Karmel westward, and to Brook Shiḥor Liḇnath,
19.27: and turned toward the sunrise, to Bĕyth Daḡon, and reached to Zeḇulun and to the Valley of Yiphthaḥ Ĕl, then northward beyond Bĕyth ha’Ĕmeq and Ne’i’ĕl, and went out to Kaḇul which was on the left,
19.28: and Ḥeḇron, and Reḥoḇ, and Ḥammon, and Qanah, as far as Great Tsiḏon.
19.29: And the border turned to Ramah and to the strong city Tsor, and the border turned to Ḥosah, and ended at the sea, from the coast to Aḵziḇ.
19.30: And Ummah, and Aphĕq, and Reḥoḇ were included - twenty-two cities with their villages.
19.31: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ashĕr for their clans, these cities with their villages.
19.32: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, for the children of Naphtali for their clans.
19.33: And their border was from Ḥĕleph, from the terebinth tree in Tsa’anannim, and Aḏami Neqeḇ, and Yaḇne’ĕl, as far as Laqqum, and it ended at the Yardĕn.
19.34: And the border turned westward to Aznoth Taḇor, and went out from there toward Ḥuqoq, and reached to Zeḇulun on the south side and Ashĕr on the west side, and ended at Yahuḏah by the Yardĕn toward the sunrise.
19.35: And the cities of defense were Tsiddim, Tsĕr, and Ḥammath, Raqqath, and Kinnereth,
19.36: and Aḏamah, and Ramah, and Ḥatsor,
19.37: and Qeḏesh, and Eḏre’i, and Ĕyn Ḥatsor,
19.38: and Yiron, and Miḡdal Ĕl, Ḥorĕm, and Bĕyth Anath, and Bĕyth Shemesh - nineteen cities with their villages.
19.39: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali for their clans, the cities with their villages.
19.40: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan for their clans.
19.41: And the border of their inheritance was Tsor’ah, and Eshta’ol, and Ir Shemesh,
19.42: and Sha’alabbin, and Ayalon, and Yithlah,
19.43: and Ĕylon, and Timnathah, and Eqron,
19.44: and Elteqĕh, and Gibbethon, and Ba’alath,
19.45: and Yahuḏ, and Benĕy Beraq, and Gath Rimmon,
19.46: and Mĕy Yarqon, and Raqqon, with the border before Yapho.
19.47: And the border of the children of Dan went out from them. And the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem and captured it. And they smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt in it, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
19.48: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan for their clans, these cities with their villages.
19.49: And when they had ended dividing the land as an inheritance according to their borders, the children of Yisra’ĕl gave an inheritance to Yahoshua son of Nun in their midst.
19.50: According to the word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 they gave him the city which he asked for, Timnath Seraḥ in the mountains of Ephrayim. And he built the city and dwelt in it.
19.51: These were the inheritances which El’azar the kohĕn, and Yahoshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl divided as an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, at the door of the Tent of Appointment. And they ended dividing the country.

2.1: And Yahoshua son of Nun secretly sent out two men from Shittim to spy, saying, “Go, see the land, and Yeriḥo.” And they went, and came to the house of a woman, a whore, and her name was Raḥaḇ, and they lay down there.
2.2: But it was reported to the meleḵ of Yeriḥo, saying, “See, men from the children of Yisra’ĕl have come here tonight to search out the land.”
2.3: And the meleḵ of Yeriḥo sent to Raḥaḇ, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to search out all the land.”
2.4: But the woman had taken the two men and hid them. So she said, “The men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
2.5: “Then it came to be as the gate was being shut, when it was dark, that the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, so that you overtake them.”
2.6: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid out on the roof.
2.7: And the men pursued them by the way to the Yardĕn, to the fords. And they shut the gate afterwards as soon as the pursuers had gone out.
2.8: And before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof,
2.9: and she said to the men, “I know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away because of you.
2.10: “For we have heard how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 dried up the water of the Sea of Reeds for you when you came out of Mitsrayim, and what you did to the two melaḵim of the Amorites who were beyond the Yardĕn, Siḥon and Oḡ, whom you put under the ban.
2.11: “And when we heard, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in anyone because of you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, He is Elohim in the shamayim above and on earth beneath.
2.12: “And now, please swear to me by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, since I have shown you kindness, that you also show kindness to my father’s house, and shall give me a true token,
2.13: and shall spare my father, and my mother, and my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and shall deliver our lives from death.”
2.14: And the men said to her, “Our lives for yours, if you do not expose this matter of ours, then it shall be, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has given us the land, that we shall treat you in kindness and truth.”
2.15: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall and she dwelt on the wall.
2.16: And she said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers come upon you. And you shall hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned, and afterwards go on your way.”
2.17: And the men said to her, “We are released from this oath of yours which you have made us swear,
2.18: unless, when we come into the land, you bind this line of scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you bring your father, and your mother, and your brothers, and all your father’s household to your own home.
2.19: “And it shall be that anyone who goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood is on his own head, and we are innocent. And anyone who is with you in the house, his blood is on our head if a hand is laid on him.
2.20: “And if you expose this matter of ours, then we shall be released from your oath which you made us swear.”
2.21: And she said, “Let it be according to your words.” And she sent them away, and they went. And she bound the scarlet cord in the window.
2.22: So they left and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. And the pursuers sought them in all the way, but did not find them.
2.23: Then the two men returned and came down from the mountain, and passed over. And they came to Yahoshua son of Nun, and related to him all that had befallen them.
2.24: And they said to Yahoshua, “Truly 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has given all the land into our hands, and also, all the inhabitants of the land have melted away before us.”

20.1: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Yahoshua, saying,
20.2: “Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, ‘Appoint for yourselves cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Mosheh,
20.3: for the slayer who kills any being accidentally, unintentionally, to flee there. And they shall be your refuge from the revenger of blood.
20.4: ‘And he shall flee to one of those cities, and stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the hearing of the elders of that city. And they shall take him into the city as one of them, and give him a place, and he shall dwell among them.
20.5: ‘And when the revenger of blood pursues him, they do not give the slayer into his hand, because he smote his neighbor unintentionally, and did not hate him beforehand.
20.6: ‘And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for right-ruling, and until the death of the one who is kohĕn ha’gadol in those days. Then let the slayer return and come to his own city and his own house, to the city from which he fled.’ ”
20.7: So they qadosh Qeḏesh in Galil, in the mountains of Naphtali, and Sheḵem in the mountains of Ephrayim, and Qiryath Arba, that is Ḥeḇron, in the mountains of Yahuḏah.
20.8: And beyond the Yardĕn, by Yeriḥo eastward, they appointed Betser in the wilderness on the plain, from the tribe of Re’uḇĕn, and Ramoth in Gil’aḏ, from the tribe of Gaḏ, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Menashsheh.
20.9: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Yisra’ĕl and for the stranger who sojourned in their midst, for anyone accidentally killing any being, to flee there, and not die by the hand of the revenger of blood until he stood before the congregation.

21.1: And the heads of the fathers of the Lĕwites came near to El’azar the kohĕn, to Yahoshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
21.2: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Kena’an, saying, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded through Mosheh to give us cities to dwell in, with their open land for our livestock.”
21.3: So the children of Yisra’ĕl gave to the Lĕwites from their inheritance, at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, these cities and their open land:
21.4: And the lot came out for the clans of the Qehathites. And the children of Aharon the kohĕn, who were of the Lĕwites, had thirteen cities by lot from the tribe of Yahuḏah, from the tribe of Shim’on, and from the tribe of Binyamin.
21.5: And the rest of the children of Qehath had ten cities by lot from the clans of the tribe of Ephrayim, from the tribe of Dan, and from the half-tribe of Menashsheh.
21.6: And the children of Gĕreshon had thirteen cities by lot from the clans of the tribe of Yissasḵar, from the tribe of Ashĕr, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Menashsheh in Bashan.
21.7: The children of Merari for their clans had twelve cities from the tribe of Re’uḇĕn, and from the tribe of Gaḏ, and from the tribe of Zeḇulun.
21.8: Thus the children of Yisra’ĕl gave these cities with their open land by lot to the Lĕwites, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded by the hand of Mosheh.
21.9: So from the tribe of the children of Yahuḏah and from the tribe of the children of Shim’on they gave these cities which are mentioned by name,
21.10: and they were for the children of Aharon, one of the clans of the Qehathites, who were of the children of Lĕwi, for the lot was theirs first.
21.11: And they gave them Qiryath Arba, the father of Anaq - that is Ḥeḇron - in the mountains of Yahuḏah, with the open land surrounding it.
21.12: And the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh as his possession.
21.13: But to the children of Aharon the kohĕn they gave Ḥeḇron with its open land - a city of refuge for the slayer - and Liḇnah with its open land,
21.14: and Yattir with its open land, and Eshtemoa with its open land,
21.15: and Ḥolon with its open land, and Deḇir with its open land,
21.16: and Ayin with its open land, and Yuttah with its open land, and Bĕyth Shemesh with its open land - nine cities from those two tribes.
21.17: And from the tribe of Binyamin, Giḇ’on with its open land, Geḇa with its open land,
21.18: Anathoth with its open land, and Almon with its open land - four cities.
21.19: All the cities of the children of Aharon, the kohenim, were thirteen cities with their open lands.
21.20: And the clans of the children of Qehath, the Lĕwites, the rest of the children of Qehath, even they had the cities of their lot from the tribe of Ephrayim.
21.21: And they gave them Sheḵem with its open land in the mountains of Ephrayim as a city of refuge for the slayer, and Gezer with its open land,
21.22: and Qiḇtsayim with its open land, and Bĕyth Ḥoron with its open land - four cities.
21.23: And from the tribe of Dan, Elteqĕh with its open land, Gibbethon with its open land,
21.24: Ayalon with its open land, and Gath Rimmon with its open land - four cities.
21.25: And from the half-tribe of Menashsheh, Ta’anaḵ with its open land, and Gath Rimmon with its open land - two cities.
21.26: All the ten cities with their open lands were for the rest of the clans of the children of Qehath.
21.27: And to the children of Gĕreshon, of the clans of the Lĕwites, from the other half-tribe of Menashsheh, they gave Golan in Bashan with its open land as a city of refuge for the slayer, and Be’eshterah with its open land - two cities.
21.28: And from the tribe of Yissasḵar, Qishyon with its open land, Daḇerath with its open land,
21.29: Yarmuth with its open land, and Ĕyn Gannim with its open land - four cities.
21.30: And from the tribe of Ashĕr, Mish’al with its open land, Aḇdon with its open land,
21.31: Ḥelqath with its open land, and Reḥoḇ with its open land - four cities.
21.32: And from the tribe of Naphtali, Qeḏesh in Galil with its open land as a city of refuge for the slayer, and Ḥammoth Dor with its open land, and Qartan with its open land - three cities.
21.33: All the cities of the Gĕreshonites for their clans were thirteen cities with their open land.
21.34: And to the clans of the children of Merari, the rest of the Lĕwites, from the tribe of Zeḇulun, Yoqne’am with its open land, Qartah with its open land,
21.35: Dimnah with its open land, Nahalal with its open land - four cities.
21.36: And from the tribe of Re’uḇĕn, Betser with its open land, Yahtsah with its open land,
21.37: Qeḏĕmoth with its open land, and Mĕpha’ath with its open land - four cities.
21.38: And from the tribe of Gaḏ, Ramoth in Gil’aḏ with its open land as a city of refuge for the slayer, and Maḥanayim with its open land,
21.39: Ḥeshbon with its open land, Ya’zĕr with its open land - four cities in all.
21.40: All the cities for the children of Merari for their clans, the rest of the clans of the Lĕwites, were by their lot twelve cities.
21.41: All the cities of the Lĕwites within the possession of the children of Yisra’ĕl were forty-eight cities with their open lands.
21.42: Each of these cities had its open land surrounding it. So it was with all these cities.
21.43: Thus 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave to Yisra’ĕl all the land of which He had sworn to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it, and dwelt in it.
21.44: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave them rest all around, according to all that He had sworn to their fathers. And not a man of all their enemies stood against them, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave all their enemies into their hand.
21.45: Not a word failed of any good word which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had spoken to the house of Yisra’ĕl - all came in.

22.1: Then Yahoshua called for the Re’uḇĕnites, and the Gaḏites, and half the tribe of Menashsheh,
22.2: and said to them, “You, you have guarded all that Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.
22.3: “You have not left your brothers these many days, up to this day, but have guarded the Charge, the Command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim.
22.4: “And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has given rest to your brothers, as He promised them. So now, return and go to your tents and to the land of your possession, which Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gave you beyond the Yardĕn.
22.5: “Only, diligently guard to do the Command and the Torah which Mosheh the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded you, to love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, and to walk in all His Ways, and to guard His Commands, and to cling to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your being.”
22.6: And Yahoshua baraḵ them and sent them away, and they went to their tents.
22.7: And to half the tribe of Menashsheh Mosheh had given a possession in Bashan, but to the half of it Yahoshua gave among their brothers beyond the Yardĕn, westward. So when Yahoshua sent them away to their tents, he also baraḵ them,
22.8: and spoke to them, saying, “Return to your tents with great riches, and with very much livestock, and with silver, and with gold, and with bronze, and with iron, and with countless garments. Divide the spoil of your enemies with your brothers.”
22.9: And the children of Re’uḇĕn, and the children of Gaḏ, and half the tribe of Menashsheh returned, and left the children of Yisra’ĕl at Shiloh, which is in the land of Kena’an, to go to the land of Gil’aḏ, to the land of their possession, which they possessed according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 by the hand of Mosheh.
22.10: And they came to the districts of the Yardĕn which is in the land of Kena’an, and the children of Re’uḇĕn, and the children of Gaḏ, and half the tribe of Menashsheh built an altar there by the Yardĕn, a great conspicuous altar.
22.11: And the children of Yisra’ĕl heard it saying, “See, the children of Re’uḇĕn, and the children of Gaḏ, and half the tribe of Menashsheh have built an altar opposite the land of Kena’an, in the districts of the Yardĕn, at the border of the children of Yisra’ĕl.”
22.12: And when the children of Yisra’ĕl heard, all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl assembled at Shiloh to go to fight against them.
22.13: So the children of Yisra’ĕl sent Pineḥas son of El’azar the kohĕn to the children of Re’uḇĕn, and to the children of Gaḏ, and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, into the land of Gil’aḏ,
22.14: and ten rulers with him, one ruler each from the chief house of every tribe of Yisra’ĕl. And each one was the head of the house of his father among the divisions of Yisra’ĕl.
22.15: And they came to the children of Re’uḇĕn and to the children of Gaḏ, and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, to the land of Gil’aḏ, and spoke with them, saying,
22.16: “Thus says all the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, ‘What is this trespass you have committed against the Elohim of Yisra’ĕl, to turn away this day from following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in that you have built for yourselves an altar, to rebel against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 this day?
22.17: ‘Is the wickedness of Pe’or not enough for us, from which we have not been cleansed till this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
22.18: that you turn away today from following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? And it shall be, if you rebel today against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, that tomorrow He is wroth with all the congregation of Yisra’ĕl.
22.19: ‘And indeed, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, where the Mishkan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 dwells, and take possession among us. But do not rebel against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, nor rebel against us, by building yourselves an altar besides the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim.
22.20: ‘Did not Aḵan son of Zeraḥ commit a trespass in that which is under the ban, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Yisra’ĕl? And he was not the only one to die in his wickedness.’ ”
22.21: Then the children of Re’uḇĕn, and the children of Gaḏ, and half the tribe of Menashsheh answered and said to the heads of the divisions of Yisra’ĕl,
22.22: “Ĕl Elohim 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Ĕl Elohim 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, He knows, and let Yisra’ĕl itself know. If this has been in rebellion, or if in trespass against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not save us this day.
22.23: “If we have built ourselves an altar to turn from following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, or if to offer burnt offerings or grain offerings on it, or if to make peace offerings on it, let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Himself require it.
22.24: “But truly, from reverence, for a reason we did this, saying, ‘In time to come your sons might speak to our sons, saying, “What have you to do with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl?
22.25: “For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has made the Yardĕn a border between you and us, you children of Re’uḇĕn and children of Gaḏ. You have no portion with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.” So your sons would make our sons stop revering 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.’
22.26: “So we said, ‘Let us now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering nor for slaughtering,
22.27: but to be a witness between you and us and our generations after us, to do the service of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 before Him with our burnt offerings, with our slaughterings, and with our peace offerings, that your sons should not say to our sons in time to come, “You have no portion with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.” ’ ”
22.28: “So we said that it shall be, when they say this to us or to our generations in time to come, that we shall say, ‘See the pattern of the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 which our fathers made, though not for burnt offerings nor for slaughterings, but it is a witness between you and us.’
22.29: “Far be it from us to rebel against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and to turn from following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 this day, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for grain offerings, or for slaughterings, besides the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim which is before His Mishkan.”
22.30: And Pineḥas the kohĕn and the rulers of the congregation, and the heads of the thousands of Yisra’ĕl who were with him, heard the words that the children of Re’uḇĕn, and the children of Gaḏ, and the children of Menashsheh spoke, and it was good in their eyes.
22.31: And Pineḥas son of El’azar the kohĕn said to the children of Re’uḇĕn, and to the children of Gaḏ, and to the children of Menashsheh, “Today we know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is in our midst, because you have not committed against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 this trespass. Now you have delivered the children of Yisra’ĕl out of the hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
22.32: And Pineḥas son of El’azar the kohĕn, and the rulers, returned from the children of Re’uḇĕn and the children of Gaḏ, from the land of Gil’aḏ to the land of Kena’an, to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and brought back word to them.
22.33: So the matter was good in the eyes of the children of Yisra’ĕl, and the children of Yisra’ĕl baraḵ Elohim. And they spoke no more of going against to fight, to destroy the land where the children of Re’uḇĕn and Gaḏ dwelt.
22.34: And the children of Re’uḇĕn and the children of Gaḏ called the altar, “A witness between us that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is Elohim.”

23.1: And it came to be, a long time after 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had given rest to Yisra’ĕl from all their enemies round about, that Yahoshua was old, advanced in years.
23.2: And Yahoshua called for all Yisra’ĕl, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old, advanced in years.
23.3: “And you, you have seen all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has done to all these nations because of you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is He who was fighting for you.
23.4: “See, I have divided to you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Yardĕn, with all the nations that I have cut off, as far as the Great Sea westward.
23.5: “And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim thrust them out from before you, and shall drive them out from before you, and you shall possess their land, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has promised you.
23.6: “And you shall be very strong to guard and to do all that is written in the Book of the Torah of Mosheh, so as not to turn aside from it right or left,
23.7: so as not to go in among these nations, these who remain among you. And make no mention of the name of their mighty ones, nor swear by, nor serve them nor bow down to them.
23.8: “But cling to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, as you have done to this day.
23.9: “For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has driven out from before you great and strong nations. As for you, no one has stood against you to this day.
23.10: “One man of you put a thousand to flight, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim is He who is fighting for you, as He has promised you.
23.11: “And you shall diligently guard yourselves, to love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim.
23.12: “But if you do turn back at all, and cling to the remnant of these nations, these that remain among you, and intermarry with them, and go in to them and they to you,
23.13: know for certain that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim shall no longer drive these nations out from before you. And they shall be snares and traps to you, and a whip on your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has given you.
23.14: “And see, this day I am going the way of all the earth. And you know in all your hearts and in all your beings that not one word has failed of all the good words which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim spoke concerning you. All of it has come to you, and not one word of them has failed.
23.15: “And it shall be, that as every good word has come upon you which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim promised you, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 brings upon you every evil word, until He has destroyed you from this good land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim has given you,
23.16: when you transgress the Covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, which He commanded you, and shall go and serve other mighty ones, and bow down to them. And the displeasure of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall burn against you, and you shall perish quickly from the good land which He has given you.”

24.1: And Yahoshua gathered all the tribes of Yisra’ĕl to Sheḵem and called for the elders of Yisra’ĕl, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers. And they presented themselves before Elohim.
24.2: And Yahoshua said to all the people, “Thus said 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl, ‘Long ago your fathers dwelt beyond the River - Teraḥ, the father of Aḇraham and the father of Naḥor. And they served other mighty ones.
24.3: ‘So I took your father Aḇraham from beyond the River, and caused him to go through all the land of Kena’an, and multiplied his offspring and gave him Yitsḥaq.
24.4: ‘And to Yitsḥaq I gave Ya’aqoḇ and Ĕsaw. And to Ĕsaw I gave the mountains of Sĕ’ir to possess, but Ya’aqoḇ and his children went down to Mitsrayim.
24.5: ‘Then I sent Mosheh and Aharon, and plagued Mitsrayim, as I did in their midst. And afterward I brought you out.
24.6: ‘And I brought your fathers out of Mitsrayim, and you came to the sea. And the Mitsrites pursued your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Sea of Reeds.
24.7: ‘And they cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and He put thick darkness between you and the Mitsrites, and brought the sea upon them and covered them. And your eyes saw what I did in Mitsrayim. And you dwelt in the wilderness a long time.
24.8: ‘And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who dwelt beyond the Yardĕn, and they fought with you. But I gave them into your hand, and you possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.
24.9: ‘And Balaq son of Tsippor, meleḵ of Mo’aḇ, rose up and fought against Yisra’ĕl, and sent and called for Bil’am son of Be’or to curse you.
24.10: ‘But I refused to listen to Bil’am, so he continued to baraḵ you, and I delivered you out of his hand.
24.11: ‘And you passed over the Yardĕn and came to Yeriḥo. And the masters of Yeriḥo, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Kena’anite, and the Ḥittite, and the Girgashite, and the Ḥiwwite, and the Yeḇusite fought against you. But I gave them into your hand.
24.12: ‘And I sent the hornet before you which drove them out from before you, also the two melaḵim of the Amorites, but not with your sword or with your bow.
24.13: ‘And I gave you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build. And you dwell in them, you eat of the vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant.’
24.14: “And now, revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, serve Him in perfection and in truth, and put away the mighty ones which your fathers served beyond the River and in Mitsrayim, and serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
24.15: “And if it seems evil in your eyes to serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, choose for yourselves this day whom you are going to serve, whether the mighty ones which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the mighty ones of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell. But I and my house, we serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
24.16: And the people answered and said, “Far be it from us to forsake 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to serve other mighty ones,
24.17: for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim is He who has brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Mitsrayim, from the house of bondage, who did those great signs before our eyes, and has guarded us in all the way that we went and among all the people through whom we passed.
24.18: “And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites who dwelt in the land. We too serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He is our Elohim.”
24.19: Then Yahoshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He is a qodesh Elohim, a jealous Ĕl is He. He does not bear with your transgression and with your sins.
24.20: If you forsake 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and shall serve mighty ones of a stranger, then He shall turn back and do you evil and consume you, after He has been good to you.”
24.21: And the people said to Yahoshua, “No, but we will serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!”
24.22: Then Yahoshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for yourselves, to serve Him.” And they said, “Witnesses!”
24.23: “And now, put away the mighty ones of the stranger which are in your midst, and incline your heart to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl.”
24.24: And the people said to Yahoshua, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim we serve, and His voice we obey.”
24.25: And Yahoshua made a covenant with the people that day, and laid on them a law and a right-ruling in Sheḵem.
24.26: Then Yahoshua wrote these words in the Book of the Torah of Elohim. And he took a large stone, and put it up there under the oak that was by the Miqdash of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
24.27: And Yahoshua said to all the people, “See, this stone is a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 which He spoke to us. And it shall be a witness against you, lest you lie against your Elohim.”
24.28: Then Yahoshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
24.29: And after these events it came to be that Yahoshua son of Nun, the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, died, one hundred and ten years old.
24.30: And they buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath Seraḥ, which is in the mountains of Ephrayim, on the north side of Mount Ga’ash.
24.31: And Yisra’ĕl served 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 all the days of Yahoshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Yahoshua, who had known all the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 which He had done for Yisra’ĕl.
24.32: And the bones of Yosĕph, which the children of Yisra’ĕl had brought up out of Mitsrayim, they buried at Sheḵem, in the plot of ground which Ya’aqoḇ had bought from the sons of Ḥamor the father of Sheḵem for one hundred qesitah, and which had become an inheritance of the children of Yosĕph.
24.33: And El’azar son of Aharon died, and they buried him in a hill that belonged to Pineḥas his son, which was given to him in the hill country of Ephrayim.

3.1: And Yahoshua rose early in the morning, and they departed from Shittim and came to the Yardĕn, he and all the children of Yisra’ĕl, and stayed there before they passed over.
3.2: And it came to be, after three days, that the officers went into the midst of the camp,
3.3: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the Covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, and the kohenim, the Lĕwites, bearing it, then you shall depart from your place and follow it.
3.4: “Only, keep a distance between you and it, about two thousand ammah by measure. Do not come near it, so that you know which way to go, for you have not passed over this way before.”
3.5: And Yahoshua said to the people, “Qadosh yourselves, for tomorrow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is doing wonders in your midst.”
3.6: And Yahoshua spoke to the kohenim, saying, “Take up the ark of the Covenant and pass over before the people.” So they took up the ark of the Covenant and went before the people.
3.7: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Yahoshua, “This day I begin to make you great before the eyes of all Yisra’ĕl, so that they know that I am with you as I was with Mosheh.
3.8: “And you, command the kohenim who bear the ark of the Covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the edge of the water of the Yardĕn, stand in the Yardĕn.’ ”
3.9: And Yahoshua said to the children of Yisra’ĕl, “Come near, and hear the words of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim.”
3.10: And Yahoshua said, “By this you shall know that the living Ĕl is in your midst, and that He is certainly driving out from before you the Kena’anites and the Ḥittites and the Ḥiwwites and the Perizzites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Yeḇusites:
3.11: “See, the ark of the Covenant of the Aḏon of all the earth is passing over before you into the Yardĕn.
3.12: “And now, take for yourselves twelve men from the tribes of Yisra’ĕl, one man from every tribe.
3.13: “And it shall be, as soon as the soles of the feet of the kohenim who bear the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the Aḏon of all the earth, come to rest in the waters of the Yardĕn, that the waters of the Yardĕn are cut off, the waters that come down from upstream, and stand as a heap.”
3.14: And it came to be, when the people departed from their tents to pass over the Yardĕn, with the kohenim bearing the ark of the Covenant before the people,
3.15: and as those bearing the ark came to the Yardĕn, and the feet of the kohenim bearing the ark dipped in the edge of the water - now the Yardĕn overflows all its banks during all the time of harvest -
3.16: that the waters which came down from upstream stood still, and rose in a heap very far away at Aḏam, the city that is beside Tsarethan. And the waters going down into the Sea of the Araḇah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. And the people passed over opposite Yeriḥo.
3.17: And the kohenim bearing the ark of the Covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 stood firm on dry ground in the midst of the Yardĕn. And all Yisra’ĕl passed over on dry ground, until all the nation had completely passed over the Yardĕn.

4.1: And it came to be, when the entire nation had completely passed over the Yardĕn, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Yahoshua, saying,
4.2: “Take for yourselves twelve men from the people, one man from every tribe,
4.3: and command them, saying, ‘Take for yourselves twelve stones from here, out of the midst of the Yardĕn, from the place where the kohenim’s feet stood firm. And you shall bring them with you and leave them in the camp in which you spend the night.’ ”
4.4: And Yahoshua called the twelve men whom he had appointed from the children of Yisra’ĕl, one man from every tribe,
4.5: and Yahoshua said to them, “Pass over before the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim into the midst of the Yardĕn, and each one of you take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl,
4.6: so that this shall be a sign in your midst when your children ask in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean to you?’
4.7: “Then you shall answer them that the waters of the Yardĕn were cut off before the ark of the Covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. When it passed over the Yardĕn, the waters of the Yardĕn were cut off. And these stones shall be for a remembrance to the children of Yisra’ĕl forever.”
4.8: And the children of Yisra’ĕl did so, as Yahoshua commanded, and took up twelve stones from the midst of the Yardĕn, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had spoken to Yahoshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ĕl, and took them over with them to their camp, and laid them down there.
4.9: Yahoshua also put up twelve stones in the midst of the Yardĕn, in the place where the feet of the kohenim who bore the ark of the Covenant stood. And they are there to this day.
4.10: And the kohenim who bore the ark stood in the midst of the Yardĕn until every matter was finished that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded Yahoshua to speak to the people, according to all that Mosheh had commanded Yahoshua. And the people hastened and passed over.
4.11: And it came to be, when all the people had completely passed over, that the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and the kohenim passed over in the presence of the people.
4.12: And the sons of Re’uḇĕn, and the sons of Gaḏ, and half the tribe of Menashsheh passed over armed before the children of Yisra’ĕl, as Mosheh had spoken to them.
4.13: About forty thousand armed ones of the army passed over before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for battle, to the desert plains of Yeriḥo.
4.14: On that day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 made Yahoshua great before the eyes of all Yisra’ĕl. And they revered him, as they had revered Mosheh, all the days of his life.
4.15: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 spoke to Yahoshua, saying,
4.16: “Command the kohenim who bear the ark of the Witness, and let them come up from the Yardĕn.”
4.17: And Yahoshua commanded the kohenim, saying, “Come up from the Yardĕn.”
4.18: And it came to be, when the kohenim who bore the ark of the Covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had come from the midst of the Yardĕn, and the soles of the kohenim feet touched the dry land, that the waters of the Yardĕn returned to their place and flowed over all its banks as before.
4.19: And the people came up from the Yardĕn on the tenth day of the first month, and they camped in Gilgal on the east border of Yeriḥo.
4.20: And those twelve stones which they took out of the Yardĕn, Yahoshua put up in Gilgal.
4.21: And he said to the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What are these stones?’
4.22: then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Yisra’ĕl passed over this Yardĕn on dry land,’
4.23: for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim dried up the waters of the Yardĕn before you until you had passed over, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim did to the Sea of Reeds, which He dried up before us until we had passed over,
4.24: so that all the peoples of the earth shall know the hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, that it is strong, so that you shall revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim forever.”

5.1: And it came to be, when all the melaḵim of the Amorites who were beyond the Yardĕn westward, and all the melaḵim of the Kena’anites who were by the sea, heard that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had dried up the waters of the Yardĕn from before the children of Yisra’ĕl until we had passed over, that their heart melted. And there was no spirit in them any longer, because of the children of Yisra’ĕl.
5.2: At that time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Yahoshua, “Make knives of flint for yourself, and circumcise the sons of Yisra’ĕl again the second time.”
5.3: So Yahoshua made knives of flint for himself, and circumcised the sons of Yisra’ĕl at the Hill of Foreskins.
5.4: And this is why Yahoshua circumcised them: All the people who came out of Mitsrayim who were males, all the men of battle, had died in the wilderness on the way, after they had come out of Mitsrayim.
